title: PRO Viewer Configuration
description: Configuration settings for PRO Viewer: defines questionnaires; maps questionnaire items with domains & scores with observation definitions; defines score ranges and score health correlations; defines global health dimensions

scoreDefinitions.description: Defines range and score health correlation of scores
scoreDefinitions.$comment: If there exists a FHIR ObservationDefinition with ObservationDefinition.qualifiedInterval.range defined for a score also occuring in the config file, the values in the config file are given priority over those in the ObservationDefinition

range.description: Specifies the range of the score as a tuple of two numbers (min, max)

scoreHealthCorrelation.description: Specifies the health score correlation; either increase (higher scores mean better health) or decrease (higher scores mean worse health)

questionnaire.description: Canonical URI of FHIR Questionnaire resource

domain.description: Domain into which items are grouped

itemId.$comment: This value should correspond to a linkId in the referenced Questionnaire resource

shortName.description: Short name that should be displayed in the chart
shortName.$comment: Useful if FHIR Questionnaire.item.text is not defined or item.linkId very long

observationDefinition.description: Canonical URI of FHIR ObservationDefinition resource

scoreDefinitionId.description: Id of an item in scoreDefinitions
scoreDefinitionId.$comment: Must match an id from scoreDefinitions

isDimensionScore.description: Flag that determines whether the item is treated as a score for a health dimension
isDimensionScore.$comment: Scores of a questionnaire which are not global health scores should be marked as dimension scores. Sometimes even simple items can be dimension scores

dimension.description: Dimension to which is measured by the item
dimension.$comment: If isDimensionScore is set to true, a dimension must be given. If the isDimensionScore is not set, an item is assigned to a dimension either through the value in this field or through reference in a dimension score's calculation expression

items.description: Id of an item that represents a global or overall health score
items.$comment: Must match an itemId from questions of the domainItemMapping array
